timing: Fixed before any real mining output; build and canned smoke only in this session.
reference: RBCTest (Huynh et al., ICSE 2026, arXiv:2504.17287), adapted from observation, confirmation and semantic verification; not a reimplementation.
cohort: All 133 non-design tasks for contract agreement; DEV only for HumanEval+ input rejection and offline PF. Never pilot/design offline labels.
draws: facts.fuzz_inputs(base_args, Random(20261010+task), valid=None), original 400 distinct seeded unfiltered candidates; no validator-dependent refill for agreement.

agreement.aggregation: per task and pooled micro counts; list tasks accepting or rejecting all nonempty draws

mining: Per-task candidate/confirmed/surviving counts; dropped candidate reasons and evidence; verifier reject/raise/timeout records; predicate hashes.
plus: DEV-only plus_input rejection counts/rates, evaluation only and never fed back into mining or method parameters.

tables: fact-weighted mean PF and matched base
per-task better/worse, ties/no-score, exact two-sided sign p
2000 same-pool uniform random draws at K=3/5, seed 20261010+K

decision: No changes to mining, generator, ranking, gates or settings follow from these numbers. v3m is primary; v3c is the contract upper bound, offline only unless requested.
